loginIntro: Enter your station account details to continue.
welcomeIntro: Your station information and account access.
offlineHelp: Your form stays open. Reconnect before submitting.
accountIntro: Your access is assigned by your station administrator.
superadminBody: Manage stations, create initial owners, control system users and review system activity from the menu.
errorGeneric: Unable to complete the request. Please try again.
errorNetwork: Unable to reach the server. Your entries have been kept. Check your connection and try again.
errorAccess: Your station access is unavailable. Contact your administrator.
errorSelection: Choose an assigned station to continue.
errorCsrf: Your security session has expired. Please try again.
errorThrottled: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errorValidation: Please check the information and try again.
errorStation: Station setup is incomplete. Contact your administrator.
noRecords: No records yet. Add the first record to get started.
overrideHelp: Inherit uses the station's role permissions. Allow or deny creates an individual exception.
title: Title
rolesHelp: Configure station roles and individual access exceptions.
priceHistoryHelp: Prices are preserved each time purchase or selling prices change.
logoHelp: PNG, JPEG or WebP; up to 2 MB and 2048 × 2048 pixels.
passwordHelp: Use at least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords and personal details.
stationSettingsHelp: Configure station details, branding and operational preferences.
reversalHelp: Reversals preserve the original record and post opposite stock/cash entries. Enter a clear reason.
reverseMeterHelp: Only reverse an erroneous latest meter entry. This also restores the preceding meter and stock; verify the actual meter first.
selectNozzlesHelp: Choose the nozzles you will operate, then start your shift.
closeShiftHelp: Confirm every final meter, then count your drawer. Record any unposted liters before closing.
stockHelp: Book stock follows posted deliveries, meter sales and approved adjustments. Physical readings preserve the measured variance.
dailyClosingHelp: Close all shifts and record fresh physical stock before counting station cash and closing the day.
creditLimitHelp: Set the customer's allowed credit before recording udhaar sales. A zero limit allows no new credit.
fuelOperationsHelp: Start a shift, record closing meters and receive payments. Review stock and cash before closing the station day.
noOpenShift: No open shift. Start your shift to record fuel sales.
errorDuplicate: This submission key was already used. Refresh and check transaction history before entering changed information.
errorStock: Insufficient tank stock for this transaction.
errorMeter: Closing meter must exceed the current recorded meter.
errorAllocation: Payments must equal the calculated total and cannot exceed the outstanding balance.
errorCredit: Choose an active customer with enough allowed credit.
errorCash: Insufficient cash. Check the cash book and opening fund.
errorFinalMeters: Record all sold liters and confirm every final meter before closing or measuring stock.
errorDrawer: A manager must approve this cash difference with a reason.
errorClosedDay: The station day is closed. An authorized administrator must reopen it before posting.
errorClosedShift: The shift is closed. Reopen it before making corrections.
errorBusy: The attendant or nozzle already has an active assignment.
errorEquipment: Choose active equipment with a ready pump and connected tank.
errorLatest: Later records prevent this reversal or reopening. Only the latest safe record can be changed.
errorReason: Enter a clear reason for the correction or cash difference.
errorPhysical: Close shifts and record fresh physical readings for all active tanks.
errorAlreadyReversed: This transaction has already been reversed.
errorStartShift: Start your shift before receiving payments.
errorPayload: This request is too large. Reduce its size and try again.
loginHeadline: A clear view of your fuel station
loginStory: Keep fuel, stock and cash in order. One place for your station's daily work.
loginStationMissing: Station branding is unavailable. Check the station code or use the general login.
loginAccessHelp: Use the account provided by your station owner or administrator.
loginFooter: Built for the daily work of a fuel station.
publicLogoHelp: Your station name and logo appear on its public login page. Upload branding only.
dashboardGuideIntro: A few steps for your role. Your available actions follow the permissions assigned to you.
guideOwnerSetup: Add your logo and station details, then configure products, tanks, pumps and nozzles before selling fuel.
guideOwnerTeam: Create employee accounts and assign roles. Workers use a simple shift screen; managers oversee station operations.
guideManagerOperations: Start or review attendant shifts. Record sales from actual nozzle meters and check cash handovers.
guideOwnerReview: Review sales, stock and station cash. Check differences and complete the daily closing after all shifts are settled.
guideManagerStock: Record supplier deliveries into the correct tank. Close related shifts before recording physical stock or adjustments.
guideManagerClose: Confirm final meters and counted cash. Explain differences before closing a shift or the operating day.
guideWorkerStart: Choose your assigned nozzles and enter your opening cash. Check the displayed meter before you begin.
guideWorkerSale: Choose a nozzle and enter its new meter reading. The system calculates liters and the amount; confirm the payment and print the receipt.
guideWorkerClose: Enter each nozzle's final meter, count the cash in your drawer and submit the handover. Ask your manager about any difference.
guideAccountantReview: Review sales and payment histories. Use filters to find a transaction and open its receipt when needed.
guideAccountantPayments: Check customer balances and record collections against the correct customer, using the actual payment method.
guideAccountantCash: Review deposits, withdrawals and cash collections, then compare counted cash during daily closing. Full accounting reports are not yet available.
guideAdminStations: Create a station with its initial owner. Edit the station to upload its logo and share its branded login link.
guideAdminUsers: Create system accounts and assign station memberships. Station operations require an active membership even for a Super Admin.
guideAdminAudit: Review platform activity and station status. Use private credentials and deactivate access when an employee leaves.
guideSafePosting: Check amounts before saving. Correct important transactions through a reasoned reversal; never record a second transaction just because a request is slow.
